summary: The Add/Edit Dataset Type dialog now opens an app-styled Data Format list instead of the browser's native dropdown.
details: The list matches the Category picker beside it: trigger-aligned width, compact hover and selected rows, and correct colors in Dark and High Contrast themes.
The field can be opened and navigated from the keyboard, and shows a muted 'Select data format' placeholder until Triangle or Vector is chosen.
Triangle and Vector remain the only accepted values, and a rejected save now returns focus to the visible field.
